title: Lesson 4: Making it concrete
html:
This is where it all gets concrete. The work this week is your planning workbook, available here — keep it somewhere safe and bring it to the session.

Work through it in order: first the quick “Where should you focus?” scan to decide which pathways to concentrate on, then your career plan (the 80,000 Hours template), your donations, your advocacy, and being a multiplier — plus getting involved in the community, which everyone should do whatever else they prioritise. The career section ends with cause-specific resources for whichever area you choose, and you finish by writing your theory of change, pulling it all together.
